caption_draft:
Your first app needs somewhere to keep its data. These 6 have a free plan.

Supabase — https://supabase.com/pricing — 500 MB database on the free plan
MongoDB Atlas — https://www.mongodb.com/resources/basics/databases/cloud-databases/free-cloud-database — 512 MB free cluster, no credit card
Neon — https://neon.com/docs/introduction/plans — 100 free Postgres projects
Firebase Firestore — https://firebase.google.com/pricing — 50K free reads a day
Turso — https://turso.tech/pricing — 100 free databases, 5GB storage
Cloudflare D1 — https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/platform/limits/ — 10 free databases per account

Save this for the day your app needs a login or a database. Send it to the friend whose app forgets everything on refresh.

#webdev #database #backend #supabase #mongodb #firstyear #students #notyourcollege
